action.label: Action / Shonen
action.rhythm: Fast cutting that accelerates into the hit. Brief stillness right before impact, then a burst of very short cuts.
vocabulary: insert of a weapon or fist
action.guidance: Open on one establishing shot, then tighten. Use at least one extreme close-up on eyes and one impact frame. The clash should be the shortest cut.

romance.label: Romance / Slice of life
romance.rhythm: Slow, lingering holds. Let silence breathe. Cut on glances, not on action.
vocabulary: pillow shot (sky, power lines, petals, train wires)
romance.guidance: Start or end on a pillow shot of the environment. Keep characters physically apart in the frame until the emotional beat, then bring them together.

horror.label: Horror / Suspense
horror.rhythm: Slow build with long static holds, then one abrupt short cut for the scare, then a held aftermath.
vocabulary: extreme close-up of a frozen face
high-angle looking down on the victim
darkness with a single light source
horror.guidance: Show the space before the threat. Keep the threat partially hidden. The scare shot should be the shortest cut, followed by a long held reaction.

comedy.label: Comedy
comedy.rhythm: Setup, beat, punchline. A deadpan hold before the punchline, then a smash cut.
comedy.guidance: Establish normal first. Hold a deadpan beat (2-3s) right before the punchline. The punchline is a chibi or exaggerated reaction shot.

mystery.label: Mystery / Drama
mystery.rhythm: Measured and deliberate. Cut to clues and to faces reading them.
mystery.guidance: Every clue gets its own insert shot. Follow each insert with a reaction close-up. End on an unresolved image.

sports.label: Sports / Climax
sports.rhythm: Accelerating toward the decisive moment, which is frozen and held.
sports.guidance: Intercut the competitors' faces. The decisive moment is a frozen mid-air or mid-swing shot held longer than its neighbours, followed by a crowd or teammate reaction.
